We will discuss in Appendix C how to adapt their algorithm for our settings with the presence of Laplace components. In this section, we show that moment-based methods are not useful for parameter estimation for mixture models under the SFD condition. To illustrate our moment-matching result, we study mixtures of Laplace distributions. This lower bound is information-theoretic and builds on the pigeonhole argument of [ regev_learning_2017 ] .
